question: Where was the 12th World Government Summit, 2025, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dubai, UAE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **12th World Government Summit (2025)** was held in **Dubai, UAE**, a city globally recognized for hosting high-profile international events and conferences.
 
• The summit is an annual event that convenes leaders, policymakers, and innovators from around the world to discuss pressing global challenges and opportunities.
 
• **Dubai, UAE**, serves as the permanent venue for the World Government Summit, showcasing its commitment to becoming a hub for innovation, governance, and futuristic strategies.
 
• The summit focuses on topics such as **climate change**, **technology advancements**, **AI governance**, and **global economic strategies**.
 
• The 12th edition in **2025** continued its legacy of promoting international collaboration, featuring delegates from over **150 countries** and leading organizations.
